## Purpose

Describe the user problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
- [ ] No user data is added to logs, URLs, analytics, or fixtures.
- [ ] New third-party material is recorded with its license.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.

## Processing and privacy

State whether this change adds network access, storage, analytics, advertising, or
server cost. Write “None” when it does not.

## Visual evidence

Include screenshots or recordings for user-visible changes, using synthetic data only.
